criteria.label: Buried winner
criteria.test: The ground that wins on its own is not first

criteria.label: Can't rule from it
criteria.test: A judge reading only this sentence could not tell what to grant and why

criteria.label: Throat-clearing
criteria.test: Procedural recital, "respectfully submits," restating the caption

criteria.label: Overclaim
criteria.test: Asserts more than the record or law supports — a candor risk

criteria.label: Missing ask
criteria.test: The relief sought (dismissal with prejudice) is absent or vague

criteria.label: Fog
criteria.test: An abstraction where a fact would do the work

criteria.label: Wrong fight
criteria.test: Argues a point the plaintiff can cure by amendment

criteria.label: Keeper
criteria.test: The best sentence in the draft — learner and master may mark one per draft
